name: Schwelm (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Schwelm (a red castle with towers on yellow above waves).
history: The right to bear a banner and a flag was granted to the city by deed of the North Rhine-Westphalian state government in 1950; the flag is red and white striped horizontally with the city arms at the centre.

features.role: Schwelm arms — castle above waves on yellow
